content.text: {"what_it_is":{"claims":[{"text":"The Ballistic Missile Defense Test program (budget code 0603914C) is run by the Missile Defense Agency (MDA) and funds flight, ground, and cyber testing of the Missile Defense System.","citation":{"fact_id":"7e19a57596d52bec"}},{"text":"MDA describes the program's purpose as testing that provides critical data to determine the validity of models and simulations used to verify and assess Missile Defense System capabilities, validate that elements and components are properly designed, built, and integrated, and provide confidence that the Missile Defense System will perform as designed.","citation":{"fact_id":"7e19a57596d52bec"}},{"text":"The program's largest project is the BMDS Test Program (project number MT04), which groups activities into six major areas: Golden Dome, Program Planning and Operations, Flight Test, Ground Test, Test Infrastructure, and Engineering & Test Analysis.","citation":{"fact_id":"c94201daeed8e38b"}},{"text":"The program also includes a Cyber Operations project (project number MC04) covering Risk Management Framework standards, controls validation testing, and certification and accreditation activities for MDA test systems.","citation":{"fact_id":"c4b5c5aa6ff1d4ef"}},{"text":"A Program Wide Support project (project number MD40) covers non-headquarters management costs, such as security, facilities, and support services, that are allocated on a pro-rata basis across most MDA program elements.","citation":{"fact_id":"3e337fe637f48ac5"}},{"text":"The Flight Test element integrates, manages, and executes flight tests using certified personnel and standardized processes to support Missile Defense System fielding to the warfighter.","citation":{"fact_id":"c94201daeed8e38b"}},{"text":"The Ground Test element plans, designs, manages, integrates, and executes ground and cyber tests, and delivers and sustains critical ground test infrastructure.","citation":{"fact_id":"c94201daeed8e38b"}}]},"why_it_matters":{"claims":[{"text":"The program's total funding is set to rise sharply from about $351.9 million in fiscal year 2025 to about $650.1 million in fiscal year 2026 — an increase of roughly $298.2 million, or about 85%.","citation":{"fact_id":"d1e1810150a29532"}},{"text":"The fiscal year 2026 total of $650.1 million (in thousands of dollars) is well above the $358.7 million actually spent in fiscal year 2024, showing a substantial expansion of the test program.","citation":{"fact_id":"937087bcd2227530"}},{"text":"The fiscal year 2026 request combines a discretionary base request of $463.1 million with an additional $187.0 million requested through reconciliation, together making up the $650.1 million total.","citation":{"fact_id":"b2413c3771c7c101"}},{"text":"The $187.0 million reconciliation request accounts for the difference between the discretionary portion and the total fiscal year 2026 figure.","citation":{"fact_id":"b8e76e066f9ecf79"}},{"text":"MDA states that a President's January 27, 2025 Executive Order established a goal of protecting U.S. citizens and critical infrastructure against missile attack, and that this budget submission reflects changes necessary to meet that evolving mission.","citation":{"fact_id":"7e19a57596d52bec"}},{"text":"The program has drawn a cumulative $3.71 billion across all prior years, indicating a long-running, sustained investment in missile defense testing.","citation":{"fact_id":"530f64d06c93d790"}}]},"players":{"claims":[{"text":"The program is managed by the Missile Defense Agency (MDA), within the Research, Development, Test and Evaluation, Defense-Wide account.","citation":{"fact_id":"7e19a57596d52bec"}},{"text":"Lockheed Martin Corporation filed lobbying disclosures in 2024 that referenced missile-related matters, including filings describing 'F-35 funding, Army Missile Defense.'","citation":{"fact_id":"0660b6f1a3db335b"}},{"text":"A Lockheed Martin filing referenced the Department of Defense Appropriations Act, 2026, including issues related to space and missile defense.","citation":{"fact_id":"002d7f7f516bc2f9"}},{"text":"The Boeing Company filed lobbying disclosures referencing missile-related matters, including the FY24 and FY25 Department of Defense Appropriations Acts.","citation":{"fact_id":"005fc74423472220"}},{"text":"A Boeing filing referenced the H.R.4016 and S.2572 Department of Defense Appropriations Act, 2026.","citation":{"fact_id":"01bfec7dbc6c2604"}},{"text":"Northrop Grumman Corporation filed a 2026 lobbying disclosure referencing missile-related matters and defense appropriations and authorization acts.","citation":{"fact_id":"0d2a841400d53f8e"}}]},"recent_developments":{"claims":[]}}
